subtitle.ar: حديثان في الشهادة والحوض، من دروس العقائد النسفية
subtitle.en: Two hadiths — the testimony and the Basin — from the Nasafi creed lessons
subtitle.tr: Kelime-i şehadet ve Havz hakkında iki hadis — Nesefî akaid derslerinden

attribution.ar: نصوص عربية منقولة من دروس العقائد النسفية (الصحيفة ١ و ١٢)، مضبوطة ومقطَّعة للدراسة.
attribution.en: Arabic passages quoted in the Nasafi creed lesson notes supplied by the project owner (pages 1 and 12), transcribed from the printed pages and segmented for study. The surrounding exposition in that source is in Ottoman Turkish; only its Arabic quotations are used here. Wording to be checked against a critical hadith edition before publication.
